intent.text: Add session-based authentication, and make sure the platform health check keeps working.
acceptanceCriteria: Running `npm run test` must pass, confirming that the existing test suite continues to pass.
A GET request to `/health` must remain reachable without authentication, and the response must report 'ok'.
A GET request to `/api/me` must return a 401 Unauthorized status code when the caller has no active session.
The application must successfully implement session-based authentication.

steps.description: Implement session-based authentication logic in src/server.ts
Update src/app.ts to integrate session handling and ensure /health remains public
Verify that running `npm run test` passes, confirming existing tests still pass.
Verify that a GET request to `/health` is reachable without authentication and reports 'ok'.
Verify that a GET request to `/api/me` returns 401 Unauthorized when no session is present.

risks: Implementing session-based authentication might inadvertently break the existing test suite or the public `/health` endpoint if not handled carefully.
The implementation of session management in `src/server.ts` and `src/app.ts` could introduce regressions in existing functionality.
verificationStrategy: Run `npm run test` to confirm all existing tests pass.
Manually or via integration tests, verify GET /health is accessible publicly and returns 'ok'.
Manually or via integration tests, verify GET /api/me returns 401 when unauthenticated.

evidence.originalIntent: Add session-based authentication, and make sure the platform health check keeps working.
evidence.interpretation: The goal is to implement session-based authentication in the application while ensuring that the platform health check endpoint remains accessible without any authentication.
